one_line: Independent NCBI-based replication confirms counts, novelty metrics, and strong MGE association for 21 E. coli anti-phage systems; global distribution only spot-checked and wet-lab EOP untestable.
justification: We fully verified the strain set (C1), system and component counts (C2), annotation status (C3), and Gao-seed novelty metrics (C4), and independently supported domain-level detectability challenges. We strongly confirmed the MGE/prophage context for all systems using ±15 kb neighborhood scans (C6). The broad taxonomic distribution (C5) was only partially assessed and the wet-lab EOP phenotypes (C7) cannot be tested computationally. Agreement with reported numbers is near-exact for all attempted claims.
